Fundamentals angad of Computer

Computer ek aisi electronic machine hai jo user se input leti hai, use process karti hai aur result (output) deti hai.

Main Parts of Computer

  • CPU: Ise computer ka dimaag (Central Processing Unit) kaha jata hai.
  • Memory: Data aur instructions ko store karne ki jagah (jaise RAM aur ROM).
  • Input Devices: Data enter karne ke liye, jaise Mouse aur Keyboard.
  • Output Devices: Result dekhne ke liye, jaise Monitor aur Printer.

Charles Babbage ko Computer ka pita (Father of Computer) kaha jata hai. Hardware aur software dono milkar ek computer system ko chalate hain.
